entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Anyway, based on what Crow was saying,[n]the games in here are all totally rigged.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oooh, so we're gonna catch 'em in the act![n]I guess that's easy... C'mon, let's get to it!

entries.speaker: Shadow
entries.en: Here you will be playing a game that[n]requires you to match the patterns on[n]the rotating wheels.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We're here to make money, not to play[n]your games!

entries.speaker: Shadow
entries.en: But you will have to defeat me first!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It appears we cannot avoid interferences[n]in here.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wait, why aren't the guests around us[n]reacting to our battle?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: That might be Sae-san's perception[n]towards the people of the court.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Even though you fight to carry out[n]justice... their indifference leads you[n]to feeling isolated.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Even over here, there are Shadows[n]attacking us...
